hero.title: About {Bonfiire}
hero.text: Bonfiire is where students find things to do, host their own events and bring people together, from a park hangout to an Appro across the city.

values.title: What we are {building}
text: Everyone is busy with their own life, and technology keeps changing how we live. We want to use that technology to do something simple: bring people together.
Bonfiire helps you meet new people, make memories and find friends that last. From a small hangout to a big Appro, it is made for the moments you share face to face.
We build it for you, and we keep adding features based on what you need.

cta.title: Try the app and tell us what comes {next}
text: Download Bonfiire and try it out. Let us know what you want the app to include in the next version.
emailBody: I would like to know more about Bonfiire.
What I would like to know:

versions.title: From day one to today
versions.text: See where we started and what we have shipped in the app, based on the feedback and requests you have given us.

notes.heading: First launch
notes.text: The very first version of Bonfiire, released on the App Store.

notes.heading: Ticket Scanner Optimization
notes.text: Fixed a bug where the camera would constantly re-scan invalid tickets QR codes. The scanner now handles errors gracefully, improving performance and battery life.

notes.heading: Real-Time Connectivity
notes.text: Live syncing is now active for Events, Participants, Notifications, and Messages. Information updates instantly across devices.

notes.heading: Map & Marker UI
notes.text: Improved marker logic for smoother zooming. Pins now stay crisp, scale correctly, and remain easy to click without overlapping.

notes.heading: UI & Navigation Fixes
notes.text: General layout improvements across the app, specifically focusing on the Calendar and Event Details pages.

notes.heading: UI Improvements
notes.text: Corrected layout constraints in the QR code view. Fixed interface bugs across multi-location selection screens.
Ready for your next event? We’ve upgraded the app to make Appros smoother and more fun than ever!

notes.heading: Group Participation & Shared Points:
notes.text: Squad up! Join events as a group, complete group tasks, and perform check-ins as a team, earning and pooling score points collectively.

notes.heading: Color-Coded Checkpoints:
notes.text: Never lose your way on the route. Checkpoints now feature color-coded markers so you can see at a glance which stops you've completed and where to head next.

notes.heading: Interactive Mini Map:
notes.text: Preview the event map right from the Event Details page, just tap it anytime to open the full interactive map view to see all checkpoints.
Enjoying the new updates? Leave us a review and let us know how your team did!

notes.heading: Ticket sales
notes.text: Tickets are currently free, so participants can join immediately. Paid ticketing within the app is coming soon.

notes.heading: Shared album for events
notes.text: Bring the whole day together. Hosts and participants can upload their photos to one shared album so no moment gets lost.
